dialogue.soa.marjorie.attack_warning: Hit me again and you can mine alone.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.board_gift: You brought boards? Good. Dry timber matters more underground than most people think.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.0.1: If you want work, start by reading the board instead of guessing.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.0.2: A bad plan underground usually starts with someone being in a hurry.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.0.3: Take light, take food, take a way back. Then we talk.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.1.1: You came back. That already puts you ahead of most volunteers.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.1.2: Mining is not bravery. It is rhythm, patience, and leaving before greed wins.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.1.3: If you read the board twice, you usually make half as many mistakes.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.2.1: You learn fast when stone is the teacher.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.2.2: I trust you more with a lantern than most people with a sword.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.2.3: A steady hand saves more lives than loud courage.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.3.1: You know the routine now. Check the board, then check your own head.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.3.2: When you stay calm, the whole crew wastes less time recovering from mistakes.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.3.3: You are turning into someone I can actually plan around.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.4.1: If you are here, I can stop expecting the ground to surprise me twice.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.4.2: You know when to push and when to pull back. That is rare.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.4.3: Most people talk about trust. You make it practical.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.0.1: Keep your breathing slow. Panic turns tunnels smaller than they are.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.0.2: Listen to the rock before you swing. It usually warns you first.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.0.3: Do not drift out of lantern light unless you enjoy getting lost.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.1.1: Your footing is better today. Keep it that way.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.1.2: If the tunnel feels wrong, say it early. Pride is useless down here.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.1.3: A cave does not care whether your mistake was small.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.2.1: You are starting to move like someone who intends to come back alive.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.2.2: Good. You heard that crack before I did.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.2.3: Stay sharp. Comfort underground should never become laziness.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.3.1: You cover space well. Makes this work lighter.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.3.2: If the route breaks, you already know which way I want us out.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.3.3: That is the pace. No wasted swings, no wasted fear.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.4.1: I do not need to watch every step you take anymore.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.4.2: You make bad ground feel almost manageable.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.4.3: With you here, I can pay attention to the cave instead of the crew.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.mining_start: Stay close enough to see my lantern, far enough not to catch my swing.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.coal: Take the coal. Better black hands than no fire.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.diamond: A clean find. Do not waste it showing off.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.lapis: Lapis. Useful if you know how to think with it.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.torches: Take the torches. Darkness gets bold when people arrive unprepared.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.share_reward: You carried your part. Keep this and keep moving smart.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line1: Name is Soa. If you need a mine explained, speak clearly.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line2: I do not mind questions. I mind careless ones.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line3: If you are here for depth, start by respecting the way back out.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line4: Underground work is simple: keep your head, your light, and your timing.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line5: Stand where I can see you. It saves time.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line1: You listen better than most. That matters.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line2: A mine is easier on people who do not argue with every warning.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line3: Bring timber when you can. Everyone remembers the person who keeps the roof up.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line4: If you want to help, learn the route before you learn the reward.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line5: You are still green, but at least you are paying attention.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line1: I can work with someone steady. You are getting there.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line2: You do not flinch every time stone answers back anymore.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line3: Most people chase ore. The better ones watch the space around it.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line4: If I point at trouble, you move first and complain later. Good habit.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line5: You are becoming useful in the way that keeps everyone alive.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line1: I know what to expect from you now. That is worth a lot to me.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line2: You keep a level head when the cave wants drama. Keep doing that.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line3: A reliable partner makes a hard route feel shorter.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line4: If something goes wrong, I trust you to notice before it becomes a collapse.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line5: You have earned the right to hear my blunt version first.
relationship.soa.reason.board_gift_first: You brought Soa timber for the board and supports.
relationship.soa.reason.board_gift_repea: You helped Soa keep materials ready.
relationship.soa.reason.board_visit_firs: You introduced yourself at Soa's board.
relationship.soa.reason.board_visit_repe: You checked in with Soa again.
relationship.soa.reason.board_visit_thir: You proved you come back on purpose.
relationship.soa.reason.cave_first: You followed Soa safely into the mine.
relationship.soa.reason.cave_repeat: You handled another mining run with Soa.
relationship.soa.reason.interaction: You spent time talking with Soa.
relationship.soa.reason.ore_share_first: You shared ore with Soa instead of keeping it all.
relationship.soa.reason.ore_share_repeat: You kept sharing the spoils fairly.
